title: Add Announcement Banner
content: Create announcement banner. Container: fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 or relative in page flow. Banner: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white py-3 px-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-4. Icon: optional alert or megaphone icon. Text: text-sm font-medium, can include link (underline). Dismiss: button with X icon on right, absolute or flex end.

variants.simple: Create dismissible announcement banner at top of page.
variants.detailed: Create announcement banner. Container: fixed top-0 inset-x-0 z-50 or relative in page flow. Banner: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-purple-600 text-white py-3 px-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-4. Icon: optional alert or megaphone icon. Text: text-sm font-medium, can include link (underline). Dismiss: button with X icon on right, absolute or flex end.
variants.advanced: Create flexible announcement banner system. Positioning: top fixed, bottom fixed, or inline in page flow. Types: info (blue), success (green), warning (yellow), error (red), promotional (gradient). Content: text, optional icon, optional CTA link or button. Multiple banners: stack when multiple active, or show one with navigation. Dismissible: X button, click stores dismissed in localStorage (with expiry). Animation: slide down on show, slide up on dismiss. Auto-dismiss: optional timer to auto-hide. Countdown: show urgency ("Offer ends in 2 days"). Progress: optional progress bar for time-limited announcements. Responsive: text truncates on mobile with "Learn more" expansion. Scheduling: show only within date range. Targeting: show to specific user segments. A/B testing: variant support for testing messages. Link tracking: analytics on CTA clicks. Cookie consent: special handling for GDPR banners. Sticky behavior: stays visible while scrolling or scrolls with content. Accessibility: role="alert" for important announcements, dismissible via keyboard, not blocking main content. Integration: fetch active announcements from API.
